text:
Situation: Docetaxel supply is constrained at both campuses. Corvale East holds 52 units at 2.5 per day for 21 days on hand. Corvale General holds 82 units at 2.9 per day for 28 days on hand. The label for NDC 70121122301 names Amneal Oncology Pvt. Ltd. Telangana 509301 as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC as To Be Discontinued for docetaxel with an initial posting date of 2026-02-20 and a business decision to discontinue manufacture. No FDA shortage signal is posted for the plants supplying Corvale East or Corvale General.

Our position: Current inventory covers 21 to 28 days. The best option by rule is to buy from Accord Healthcare Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Additional suppliers not on the shortage list include Actavis Pharma Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, and Avyxa Pharma LLC.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Accord Healthcare Inc. as primary source; P&T committee to approve addition to formulary.
2. Buyer to qualify Actavis Pharma Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, and Avyxa Pharma LLC as backup sources; P&T committee to approve each addition.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage at both campuses and report inventory weekly; pharmacy director to approve reporting cadence.
4. Buyer to verify NDC and plant information for each new supplier upon receipt; quality assurance to approve verification.

Not recommended: Do not wait for Ingenus product to return; do not initiate clinical protocol changes without committee review.
